blockingIssues: The term/model checker correspondence theorem matrix is absent, and Checked.Model.Canonical only constrains list ordinals, permitting noncanonical checked terms for which the required round-trip theorem is false.

The mandatory fixture matrix is incomplete across output Int sums, claim-key domains, grouped boundaries, same-named/empty boxes, and numerous required single-defect category/path cases; the coverage document overstates current executable evidence.
parsed.summary: The executable checker, reconstructive eraser, independent judgments, and repository gates are substantial and compiling, but acceptance criteria 1, 3, 4, and 5 remain unmet because the central theorem families and required fixture coverage are incomplete.
